prompt: Who was the author of the novel whose film adaptation lead singer Mark Arm took the name of his band from?
answer: The novel was written by **Raymond Friday Locke**. Russ Meyer’s 1965 film *Mudhoney*, which inspired the band’s name, was adapted from Locke’s novel of the same title.
